scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w packages/public-data
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:bootstrap && npm run test:release && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
